description: How one country regulates prostitution and sex work: its legal model and, for each question, whether it is legal, the penalty, the statutory provisions, regional differences, pending bills and the official sources, with the date each answer was last checked. topics.description: Only these questions (default: all). Asking for specific ones also returns their longer explanation.
